svg.aria-label: A cumulus's profile, with height in the layer upward and the share of the shape kept across. From 0 to 0.10 it rises, a smoothstep from 0 to 1; from 0.10 to 0.60 the shape is kept whole; from 0.60 to 0.95 it falls, a smoothstep from 1 back to 0; above 0.95 nothing is kept.
